strings.zh: 大吾『你好,{NEWLINE}我是来自芳缘地区的大吾,{CLEAR}最近在关东旅行学习。{CLEAR}请问你的名字是？{SCROLL}……{SCROLL}大吾『{VAR:0103:0}吗？{NEWLINE}如果不介意的话,{CLEAR}可以跟我印证一下{CLEAR}最近学习的成果吗？
strings.en: Steven: Hello. I’m Steven, from the{NEWLINE}Hoenn region. I’ve been traveling{CLEAR}around Kanto to study lately.{SCROLL}May I ask your name?{SCROLL}...{SCROLL}Steven: {VAR:0103:0}? If you don’t mind,{NEWLINE}would you help me put what I’ve learned{CLEAR}to the test?

strings.zh: 大吾『好厉害！{NEWLINE}果然我还有许多需要学习的地方。{CLEAR}听说尼比博物馆的化石{CLEAR}都是从月见山上采集的。{CLEAR}所以我现在想去月见山参观一下。{SCROLL}大吾『{VAR:0103:0}要是有时间的话{NEWLINE}也来月见山看看吧。
strings.en: Steven: Impressive! I clearly still have{NEWLINE}a lot to learn.{SCROLL}I hear the Pewter Museum’s fossils were{NEWLINE}all collected on Mt. Moon, so I’d like to{CLEAR}go have a look there now.{SCROLL}Steven: If you have time, {VAR:0103:0}, come{NEWLINE}visit Mt. Moon too.

strings.zh: 大吾『那真是太遗憾了。
strings.en: Steven: That’s a real shame.

strings.zh: 大吾『{VAR:0103:0}！{NEWLINE}居然在这里又遇见你。{CLEAR}我最近在关东旅行,{CLEAR}学习了很多新的知识。{CLEAR}你应该也比当时更强了吧,{CLEAR}我们要不要再切磋一下试试呢？
strings.en: Steven: {VAR:0103:0}! Fancy meeting you{NEWLINE}here again.{SCROLL}I’ve learned a lot of new things on my{NEWLINE}travels through Kanto. I’m sure you’ve{CLEAR}gotten stronger since then, too.{SCROLL}What do you say to another match?

strings.zh: 你好,{NEWLINE}我是这家博物馆的馆长。{SCROLL}我们博物馆除了展出{NEWLINE}这些稀有化石外,{CLEAR}还会不定期向公众展示{CLEAR}我们博物馆的镇馆之宝。{CLEAR}要问是什么的话……{SCROLL}嘿嘿,{NEWLINE}如果将来哪一天展出的话,{CLEAR}您亲自过来看看就知道了。
strings.en: Hello. I’m the director of this museum.{SCROLL}Besides these rare fossils, now and{NEWLINE}then our museum puts its crown jewel on{CLEAR}public display.{SCROLL}As for what it is...{SCROLL}Heh heh... If it’s ever displayed, come{NEWLINE}see it for yourself and you’ll know.

strings.zh: 啊……你好,{NEWLINE}我跟秀力老师正在做{CLEAR}关于传说中精灵的研究,{CLEAR}老师可是这方面最权威的专家哦。
strings.en: Ah... Hello. Professor Hale and I are{NEWLINE}researching Legendary Pokémon. He’s{CLEAR}the top authority in this field, you{CLEAR}know.

strings.zh: 秀力博士『……{SCROLL}对方正在很认真地看着化石,{NEWLINE}还是不要打扰他了。
strings.en: Prof. Hale: ...{SCROLL}He’s studying the fossils very intently.{NEWLINE}Better not disturb him.

strings.zh: 壳之化石可以复活成化石盔,{NEWLINE}化石盔是水+岩属性的精灵。{CLEAR}化石盔进化成镰刀盔后{CLEAR}拥有不错的物理攻击力。

strings.zh: 贝之化石可以复活成菊石兽,{NEWLINE}菊石兽是水+岩属性的精灵。{CLEAR}菊石兽进化成多刺菊石兽后{CLEAR}拥有不错的物理防御力和特殊攻击力。

strings.zh: 神秘琥珀可以复活成化石翼龙,{NEWLINE}化石翼龙是飞+岩属性的精灵。{CLEAR}化石翼龙的速度极高,{CLEAR}物理攻击力也很不错。
strings.en: Old Amber can be restored into{NEWLINE}Aerodactyl, a Flying/Rock-type{CLEAR}Pokémon.{SCROLL}Aerodactyl is extremely fast, and its{NEWLINE}physical Attack is pretty good, too.

strings.zh: 根之化石可以复活成触手百合,{NEWLINE}触手百合是草+岩属性的精灵。{CLEAR}触手百合进化成摇篮百合后{CLEAR}拥有不错的双防和血量。
strings.en: The Root Fossil can be restored into{NEWLINE}Lileep, a Grass/Rock-type Pokémon.{SCROLL}Once Lileep evolves into Cradily, it has{NEWLINE}good Defense, Sp. Def and HP.

strings.zh: 爪之化石可以复活成太古羽虫,{NEWLINE}太古羽虫是草+岩属性的精灵。{CLEAR}太古羽虫进化成太古盔甲后{CLEAR}攻击力和物防都很可观。
strings.en: The Claw Fossil can be restored into{NEWLINE}Anorith, a Rock/Bug-type Pokémon.{SCROLL}Once Anorith evolves into Armaldo, both{NEWLINE}its Attack and Defense are impressive.

strings.zh: 头盖化石可以复活成头盖龙,{NEWLINE}头盖龙是岩属性的精灵。{CLEAR}头盖龙进化成战锤龙后{CLEAR}拥有无可匹敌的物理攻击力。
strings.en: The Skull Fossil can be restored into{NEWLINE}Cranidos, a Rock-type Pokémon.{SCROLL}Once Cranidos evolves into Rampardos,{NEWLINE}its physical Attack is unmatched.

strings.zh: 盾之化石可以复活成铁面龙,{NEWLINE}铁面龙是钢+岩属性的精灵。{CLEAR}铁面龙进化成护城龙后{CLEAR}双防都相当之高。
strings.en: The Armor Fossil can be restored into{NEWLINE}Shieldon, a Steel/Rock-type Pokémon.{SCROLL}Once Shieldon evolves into Bastiodon,{NEWLINE}both its Defense and Sp. Def are very{CLEAR}high.

strings.zh: 欢迎来到尼比市博物馆参观,{NEWLINE}目前我们正在展出镇馆之宝红色宝珠。{CLEAR}机会难得请慢慢欣赏。
strings.en: Welcome to the Pewter Museum of{NEWLINE}Science! Our crown jewel, the Red Orb,{CLEAR}is on display right now.{SCROLL}It’s a rare chance, so please take your{NEWLINE}time and enjoy it.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『馆长先生,我们接到情报说{NEWLINE}有可疑人员出现在博物馆,{CLEAR}你最近有发现这样的人吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Director, we got a tip that{NEWLINE}suspicious people have been seen at the{CLEAR}museum.{SCROLL}Have you noticed anyone like that{NEWLINE}lately?

strings.zh: 哎呀,小刚馆主也是这么说的。{NEWLINE}但是每天来博物馆参观的游客那么多,{CLEAR}真的很难看出到底谁有问题啊。
strings.en: Oh dear, Brock said the same thing. But{NEWLINE}so many visitors come every day, it’s{CLEAR}really hard to tell who’s up to no good.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『那博物馆里有什么东西{NEWLINE}是跟传说中的精灵有关吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Then is there anything in the{NEWLINE}museum connected to Legendary{CLEAR}Pokémon?

strings.zh: 跟传说精灵有关的……{NEWLINE}硬要说的话就是{CLEAR}正在展出的红色宝珠了。{CLEAR}据说那是唤醒大地之神的信物。
strings.en: Connected to Legendary Pokémon... If I{NEWLINE}had to name something, it would be the{CLEAR}Red Orb on display.{SCROLL}They say it’s the key to awakening the{NEWLINE}god of the land.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这么重要的东西{NEWLINE}在这个时候展出{CLEAR}是不是有点太冒险了。{CLEAR}能不能先把红色宝珠收起来,{CLEAR}等我们查明潜在的危险后{CLEAR}再考虑展出的事也不迟。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Isn’t it a bit risky to display{NEWLINE}something so important right now?{SCROLL}Could you put the Red Orb away until{NEWLINE}we’ve figured out what the danger is?

strings.zh: 冠军大人你放心吧,{NEWLINE}放置红色宝珠的罩子{CLEAR}是固定在地板上的,{CLEAR}制作罩子的材料也是非常结实,{CLEAR}就算是卡比兽使用终极冲击都撞不碎。{CLEAR}所以无论什么时候展览{CLEAR}红色宝珠都不会有事的。
strings.en: Don’t worry, Champion. The case holding{NEWLINE}the Red Orb is fixed to the floor, and{CLEAR}it’s made of extremely tough material.{SCROLL}Not even a Snorlax’s Giga Impact could{NEWLINE}break it. So the Red Orb is perfectly{CLEAR}safe on display, anytime.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这……真的能万无一失吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Is it... really foolproof?

strings.zh: 小刚『馆长您先别急,{NEWLINE}火箭队拿到红色宝珠之后{CLEAR}可能会去哪唤醒大地之神固拉多呢？

strings.zh: 我们博物馆以前做过一个研究,{NEWLINE}月见山最底层的深处的熔岩池{CLEAR}可以与红色宝珠产生共鸣。{CLEAR}所以我们推测大地之神固拉多{CLEAR}应该就沉睡在熔岩池底下。{CLEAR}火箭队如果想使用红色宝珠的话,{CLEAR}应该也会去到那里。
strings.en: Our museum once did a study. The lava{NEWLINE}pool deep in the lowest level of{CLEAR}Mt. Moon resonates with the Red Orb.{SCROLL}So we believe Groudon, the god of the{NEWLINE}land, sleeps beneath that lava pool.{SCROLL}If Team Rocket wants to use the Red{NEWLINE}Orb, they’ll surely go there too.

strings.zh: 小刚『好的,我们明白了。
strings.en: Brock: All right, we understand.

strings.zh: 小刚『{VAR:0103:0},就按刚才馆长说的,{NEWLINE}咱们现在去月见山最底层的熔岩池,{CLEAR}一定要阻止火箭队唤醒固拉多。
strings.en: Brock: {VAR:0103:0}, let’s do what the{NEWLINE}director said and head to the lava pool{CLEAR}at the bottom of Mt. Moon.{SCROLL}We have to stop Team Rocket from{NEWLINE}awakening Groudon!

strings.zh: 我不行了赤焰松大人,{NEWLINE}这个道馆馆主好厉害！
strings.en: I can’t hold out, Lord Maxie! This Gym{NEWLINE}Leader is too strong!

strings.zh: 赤焰松『喂！还没好吗？
strings.en: Maxie: Hey! Aren’t you done yet?

strings.zh: 尼比博物馆的藏品非常丰富,{NEWLINE}各式各样的化石都有。
strings.en: The Pewter Museum has a huge{NEWLINE}collection. There are all sorts of{CLEAR}fossils.

strings.zh: 还好火箭队{NEWLINE}没有打这些珍贵化石的主意。
strings.en: Thank goodness Team Rocket didn’t go{NEWLINE}after these precious fossils.

strings.zh: 这个展台里有块化石,{NEWLINE}是我当年送给尼比博物馆的哦。
strings.en: One of the fossils in this display case is{NEWLINE}one I gave to the Pewter Museum years{CLEAR}ago.

strings.zh: 火箭队真是无法无天,不可原谅！

strings.zh: 好美的红色宝珠,我要把它拍下来！

strings.zh: 火箭队刚才犯罪的过程,{NEWLINE}我都用摄像机记录下来了！
strings.en: I recorded Team Rocket’s whole robbery{NEWLINE}with my camera!

strings.zh: 来博物馆参观,真是让我大开眼界。
strings.en: Visiting the museum has really opened my{NEWLINE}eyes.

strings.zh: 呜呜呜……火箭队好吓人啊。
strings.en: Waaah... Team Rocket is so scary.

strings.zh: 红色宝珠一年就展出那么几天,{NEWLINE}看到就是赚到。
strings.en: The Red Orb is only on display a few{NEWLINE}days a year. Just getting to see it is a{CLEAR}treat.

strings.zh: 红色宝珠被抢走了,{NEWLINE}这可真是个大事件。
strings.en: The Red Orb was stolen! This is huge{NEWLINE}news.

strings.zh: 我很好奇红色宝珠{NEWLINE}到底是天然形成的石头,{CLEAR}还是人工制造的。

strings.zh: 如果火箭队{NEWLINE}想用红色宝珠做坏事,{CLEAR}那后果真是不堪设想。

strings.zh: 不愧是镇馆之宝啊,真是漂亮！

strings.zh: 这帮火箭队,把我推得好疼。

strings.zh: 我们博物馆做过很多{NEWLINE}关于红色宝珠的研究,{CLEAR}所有的研究都表明这颗宝珠{CLEAR}与被称为大地之神的口袋妖怪固拉多{CLEAR}有着非常密切的关系。
strings.en: Our museum has done a lot of research{NEWLINE}on the Red Orb.{SCROLL}Every study shows that the Orb is{NEWLINE}closely tied to Groudon, the Pokémon{CLEAR}known as the god of the land.

strings.zh: 如果固拉多的力量被火箭队盗用,{NEWLINE}那可就糟了。
strings.en: If Team Rocket steals Groudon’s power,{NEWLINE}we’ll be in real trouble.

strings.zh: 小刚『{VAR:0103:0}你也是听说了{NEWLINE}火箭队盯上了尼比市博物馆的传闻{CLEAR}才来的吧？{CLEAR}馆长先生就在我身边,{CLEAR}你有什么具体的是可以跟他打听。
strings.en: Brock: {VAR:0103:0}, you heard the rumor{NEWLINE}that Team Rocket is after the Pewter{CLEAR}Museum too, right?{SCROLL}The director is right here beside me. If{NEWLINE}you have any questions, you can ask{CLEAR}him.

strings.zh: 欢迎光临。{SCROLL}现在,镇馆之宝红色宝珠{NEWLINE}正在博物馆里展出中。{SCROLL}因此,现在这里可以免费入场！{SCROLL}请您慢慢观赏。
